bloques.html_en: Where did the first cities develop? The first cities grew up about 5,000 to 6,000 years ago, in Mesopotamia — the land between the rivers Tigris and Euphrates (in modern Iraq). Other early cities appeared along the Nile in Egypt, the Indus in Pakistan/India, and the Yellow River in China. They all grew next to rivers, because rivers gave people water, food, fertile soil for farming and transport.

🏢 What is a modern city?

A modern city is a very large settlement where a lot of people live and work. In most modern cities the land is used for:

• schools
  • hospitals
  • railway and bus stations
  • civic buildings, such as city halls or town halls
Many cities have a mixture of older and newer buildings, because the city has developed over a long period of time.
🏗️ Why are skyscrapers built in city centres?

Because land in the city centre is very expensive. To make the most of the land, people build very tall buildings called skyscrapers, which tower over the older buildings. Building upwards fits far more offices and homes onto a small, costly piece of ground.

🏦 City zones and the CBD

  • Cities may be divided into different areas or zones, each with a different purpose.
  • The middle of the city is called the central business district (CBD).
  • In the CBD you find most of the offices, banks, large shops, art galleries and museums.

🚆 How transport helped cities grow outwards

  1. Better transport — commuter trains and metros — helps cities spread outwards.
  2. More people can then live further away from the city centre and still be able to travel to work.
  3. As a result, new residential areas called suburbs develop around the edges of the city.

🔑 Key words

🏘️ Conurbations

As cities grow, they spread out into the surrounding countryside. Eventually neighbouring towns and cities may merge and become one very large urban area. This is called a conurbation.
Did you know? Sydney and Melbourne are the two largest cities in Australia. In the nineteenth century they were planned and built as important cities.
